run_slurm_pipeline_copy_raw_data: run SlurmPipelineExecutor to copy raw multilingual web data dumps from base processing to raw FineWeb output directories
create_CachedListReader: create a CachedListReader instance that shards files by dump name and yields datatrove Documents from JSONL sources
build_adapter_function: build an adapter function that transforms raw JSON dictionaries into datatrove Document format with text, id, media, and metadata fields
test_CachedListReader_run: test the CachedListReader run method to verify it correctly shards file paths across ranks and yields documents
review_CachedListReader_read_file: review the CachedListReader read_file method that parses JSONL lines with orjson and handles decode and corruption errors
